dimension_description: The coefficient of friction is dimensionless, but it still forms a useful comparative scale across lubricated bearings, skis on snow, tires on asphalt, and gecko-inspired adhesion. The meaning depends on the material pair and on whether the value is static, kinetic, or rolling, so the item labels keep that context visible.
